name: local-agent
description: Use ChatGPT with the connected GitHub app as a durable control plane for a bounded Local Agent executor running on your own computer.

interface.shortDescription: Run bounded development tasks on your own computer through GitHub.
interface.longDescription: Local Agent lets ChatGPT plan work in a repository, use GitHub as a durable authenticated control plane, and delegate bounded builds, tests, device checks, and other machine-specific commands to a Local Agent executor running on the user's computer.
defaultPrompt: Use Local Agent to inspect the current executor status for my repository.
Use Local Agent to run the relevant local tests for this repository and report the terminal evidence.
